name_input: BHIWADI POLYMERS LIMITED; BHIWADI POLYMERS LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey (India customs), page for BHIWADI POLYMERS LIMITED, 15 Najafgarh Road near Zakhira Chowk: 'Total Shipments 124 Records detected', 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-13'. Export rows actually seen (4 of 124 shown on free view): (1) 2026-01-05, BHIWADI POLYMERS LIMITED -> RATHI ADHESIVE PVT LTD, 'CHIPKO D3M 50 KGS PACK', JOGBANI INJBNB, India -> Biratnagar, NEPAL, HS 35069190, BOL 8494880; (2) 2025-12-29, -> LENNOX COOLING PLANT/UBER FREIGHT, 'TOPBOND 126H XS -ADHESIVE WATER BASED GLUE, PART NO: PQ000017 (55 GA IN 1 DRUM)', DELHI AIR CARGO ACC, India -> MEXICO CITY, UNITED STATES, HS 35069190, BOL 8287130; (3) 2025-12-06, -> TO ORDER, 'BALCOL SW Y 0.450 KGS PACK (0.450 X 20 PCS)', GARI HARSARU ICD, India -> Aden, REP YEMEN, HS 35069190, BOL 7653697. Counter: source claims 124 shipments; 4 export rows actually visible (plus 2 import rows: 2026-02-13 vinyl acetate emulsion WW-102H from ANHUI WANWEI, HS 39052100, BOL 7495800; 2025-12-22 WW-302H, HS 39052100, BOL 6452147). Named export buyers listed: YASCAI & FAMILY PLC (Ethiopia, 20 shipments), LLC BELEFEKSOFARB (Belarus, 7), CARROSION TECHNOLOGIES (USA, 4), RATHI ADHESIVE PVT LTD (Nepal, 342).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report split found in the sources read. Domestic-side trace is indirect only: the same ImportKey record shows BHIWADI POLYMERS LIMITED as buyer of imported raw material (vinyl acetate emulsion, HS 39052100) landed at GARI HARSARU ICD, i.e. an operating Indian manufacturing base at 15 Najafgarh Road, Delhi — but no domestic sale record, contract or GST figure was seen.
note: Actual shipments confirmed, not merely claimed: dated export bills of lading with destination and HS code exist (Nepal 2026-01-05, USA 2025-12-29, Yemen 2025-12-06), all under HS 35069190 (adhesives) — this matches the declared HS 350691 and corrects the declared 381190/390690, which appear in the data only as imported raw material (HS 39052100 vinyl acetate emulsion), not as exports. Verdict on HS: accepted_hs_corrected — actual export HS is 35069190. Export destinations include Belarus and Yemen counterparties; per project rules this is not a rejection ground and is recorded neutrally as 'есть сложности'. Revenue and export volume in value terms: null — ImportKey free view gives shipment counts (124 total, 4 export rows visible) but no values, and no figures were invented. Second sources volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403 and DuckDuckGo search was unavailable (connection refused), so cross-checking was limited to two ImportKey slug variants: 'bhiwadi-polymers-limited' (populated) and 'bhiwadi-polymers-ltd' (empty placeholder page). Domestic supply evidence remains unconfirmed — no GST band or public procurement record was retrievable.
